title.en: AN ACT TO PROVIDE FOR SUBMISSION TO THE CIVIL GOVERNOR OF ANNUAL REPORTS BY ALL PROVINCIAL GOVERNORS, AND REPEALING SUCH PORTIONS OF ACT NUMBERED EIGHTY-THREE, THE PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT ACT, AND ITS AMENDMENTS, AND OF ACTS AND AMENDMENTS ESTABLISHMENT GOVERNMENT FOR THE PROVINCES OF BENGUET, LEPANTO-BONTOC, NUEVA VIZCAYA, MINDORO, AND PARAGUA AS ARE INCONSISTENT WITH THE PROVISIONS OF THIS ACT.

title.vi: Đạo luật yêu cầu các Thống đốc Tỉnh nộp báo cáo thường niên cho Thống đốc Dân sự và bãi bỏ các điều khoản mâu thuẫn trong Đạo luật số 83 (Đạo luật Chính quyền Tỉnh), các sửa đổi của nó, cũng như các đạo luật và sửa đổi thành lập chính quyền cho các tỉnh Benguet, Lepanto-Bontoc, Nueva Vizcaya, Mindoro và Paragua
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติกำหนดให้ผู้ว่าราชการจังหวัดทั้งหมดยื่นรายงานประจำปีต่อผู้ว่าการพลเรือนและเพิกถอนบทบัญญัติที่ขัดแย้งในพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่83 พระราชบัญญัติการปกครองจังหวัดและฉบับแก้ไขรวมทั้งพระราชบัญญัติและฉบับแก้ไขที่จัดตั้งการปกครองสำหรับจังหวัดเบงเกตเลปันโต-บอนตอก nuevavizcaya มินโดโร และปารากัว
title.id: Undang-Undang yang mengatur penyampaian laporan tahunan oleh semua Gubernur Provinsi kepada Gubernur Sipil serta mencabut ketentuan-ketentuan dalam Undang-Undang Nomor 83, Undang-Undang Pemerintahan Provinsi dan amandemennya, serta dalam Undang-Undang dan amandemen pendirian pemerintahan untuk provinsi-provinsi Benguet, Lepanto-Bontoc, Nueva Vizcaya, Mindoro, dan Paragua yang bertentangan dengan ketentuan Undang-Undang ini
title.ms: Akta yang menghendaki semua Gabenor Wilayah menyerahkan laporan tahunan kepada Gabenor Awam dan membatalkan bahagian-bahagian dalam Akta Bilangan 83, Akta Kerajaan Wilayah dan pindaannya, serta dalam Akta-akta dan pindaan yang menubuhkan kerajaan bagi wilayah-wilayah Benguet, Lepanto-Bontoc, Nueva Vizcaya, Mindoro, dan Paragua yang tidak selaras dengan peruntukan Akta ini

text.en:
Between the first and fifteenth of July of each year a report shall be made by each provincial
governor to the Civil Governor of the Philippine Islands for the fiscal year ending on the thirtieth day of
June. This report shall embrace all matters pertinent to the administration and progress of the provincial
government, and contain full information as to the commercial, economic, financial, industrial, and political
conditions of the province, in order that the Civil Governor and the Philippine Commission may be properly
informed of the actual existing conditions in the Islands during the period covered by the report. Should
unexpected events or matters of special importance to the general welfare of the province occur subsequent
to the date of the regular annual report, a supplementary statement may also be filed, not later than
September fifteenth, in order that complete data may be at hand for the use of the Civil Governor in
submitting his annual report to the Philippine Commission: Provided, however, That this shall not apply to
the Moro Province.

Such portions of Act Numbered Eighty-three, the Provincial Government Act, and its
amendments, and of Acts and amendments thereof: providing for the establishment of civil government for
the Provinces of Benguet, Lepanto-Bontoe, Nueva Vizcaya, Mindoro, and Paragua as are inconsistent with
the provisions of this Act are hereby repealed.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.

Enacted, January 26, 1904.
